shots.title: After hours
shots.objective: Motivation; framing for objective 2 (sourcing the draft label)
captions: The Lantern Museum (a fictional museum), after closing time. The galleries are dark.
On the inspection table: a scanned object and a draft label card. Your question tonight: is this label right, and what can we say for sure?
shots.description: A slow camera move at standing eye height past three glass display cases on dark plinths, each lit by a warm spotlight, toward a wooden inspection table with a grey photographic backdrop. A small cream card lies on the table. Caption 1: The Lantern Museum (a fictional museum), after closing time. The galleries are dark. Caption 2: On the inspection table: a scanned object and a draft label card. Your question tonight: is this label right, and what can we say for sure?
shots.reducedMotion: Single still frame of the inspection table with the card, with both captions.

shots.title: The reveal
shots.objective: Objective 4 (the label as the product of the investigation)
captions: Your corrected label now stands beside the object in its case.
It says what the evidence supports, and it says what we cannot tell yet.
shots.description: The camera starts close to the centre display case, where the object now sits on dark felt under a spotlight, with a small label stand beside it showing the learner's own label text. The camera pulls back and to the right to show the whole case in the dim gallery. Caption 1: Your corrected label now stands beside the object in its case. Caption 2: It says what the evidence supports, and it says what we cannot tell yet.
shots.reducedMotion: Single still frame of the case with the object and the new label, with both captions.
